Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1228
Claimant:
Karen Carrillo
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
10-12-23
Claim reported by the claimant's representing attorney following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The
insured's vehicle was stopped when it was struck from behind by the other driver's vehicle. Policy verified and the
driver is named on the policy.
11-9-23
Recorded statement taken from the claimant, who described the impact and the sequence of events. The account
given matched what was reported at first notice of loss.
2-26-24
Police report obtained, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Responding officers and
two independent witnesses confirm the collision happened as described.
3-21-24
Photographs of the vehicle reviewed. The rear damage is consistent with the force and direction of the impact
described by all parties. A repair estimate has been requetsed from the shop.
3-23-24
Claimant reports neck and upper back pain with symptoms consistent with whiplash. Medical records show the injruy
is plausible for a crash of this type, and no prior treatment to the same area appears in the records or in the claimant's
history.
4-6-24
Treatment reviewed. Care followed a typical course of physical therapy and follow-up visits, and frequency of
treatment has reduced as the claimant's condition improved. Next scheduled review is set for the coming month.
5-6-24
A neighbor contacted the office and stated the vehicle looked damaged a few weeks before the reported loss. No
prior damage to the vehicle is known from inspection, repair history or the other driver's account, so the statement is
being noted and will be followed up with the shop's records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
